name: Jack Gomez
home: the western blocks near Ferry Street Rooms
life: “I still remember a newlywed asking for all the cleaners in the wedding picture.” Saturday often includes a stop at the blocks below Foundry Lofts, where Jack checks the little hand-lettered notices around Harbour Supply.
voice: I booked a wedding picture at that exact spot. My partner wants the crane crew in it too.
appearance: Jack has a high puff tied with plain cord, a crooked front tooth visible when laughing, and a favorite piece of clothing, a pale blue work shirt. It usually goes with a knotted piece of sail thread on a key ring. When somebody else has the floor, Jack draws breath as if to speak and lets someone else go first.
personality: Jack admires skill and distrusts the idea that skill gives anyone permission to be rude. Jack learns fastest from somebody willing to show how they made a mistake.
agenda: To include the crew in the wedding portrait.
family: Parker Anders is Jack’s second cousin. Jack makes room at the table. Parker brings whatever was actually growing or affordable that week. The meal sometimes produces a solution. Even when it does not, everyone goes away knowing what the other household is up against. Asked about *The empty chair on nights*, Parker says, “I voted against the farewell. Her leaving made me realize I need to ask for leave myself.”
connections: Zachary Teo. The design portfolio and wedding photograph both need the correct crane.

reactions.situation: A visitor reaches the quay too late to see it
reactions.response: Jack shows the visitor where the shadow fell and when the next chance comes.
reactions.asWritten: A visitor reaches the quay too late to see it. Jack shows the visitor where the shadow fell and when the next chance comes.

reactions.situation: A power cut leaves two neighbors waiting on the stairs
reactions.response: Jack asks which apartment is expecting someone home and makes sure that household knows about the delay.
